author: Jongh
body:
I recently saw that Laggehh was unbanned, after he was banned because of my triggerbot video.

Well, he got banned on Badlion's judgement day v5. I don't know how he convinced you people that he wasn't hacking but this has only cemented it in my mind that he is a hacker. Please reconsider banning him. You can Ctrl + F to find his name on this list: https://gist.github.com/mastergberry/6a802fa0e9a4b770a29b
